json.reason: Recurring API-misuse pattern: wrapping a database timestamp column in `new Date(...)`, which parses the zone-less UTC string as local time; the project contract is to use `parseDate()` for DB timestamp fields.
json.title: DB timestamp parsed with new Date() instead of parseDate()
json.message: new Date() on a database timestamp field parses the zone-less UTC string as local time; use parseDate() instead
json.note: The database stores UTC timestamps without a zone marker, so `new Date(row.date)` interprets them in the local zone and shifts dates for users outside UTC. Use `parseDate(row.date)` from "./dates", which reads the value as UTC.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  pattern: new Date($ROW.$FIELD)
constraints:
  FIELD:
    regex: "(?i)(date|_at|At|time|timestamp)$"
